questions.q: In 'The Cat and the Fox', what was the Cat's one trick?
choices: Climbing up a tree to hide
questions.evidence: In an instant the Cat was up a tree

questions.q: In 'The Cat and the Fox', why was the Fox caught by the hounds?
choices: He had so many plans he could not decide which to try first
He was too tired to run
He tried to climb a tree
questions.evidence: he could not decide which one to try first

questions.q: What is the lesson of 'The Cat and the Fox'?
choices: Common sense is always worth more than cunning
questions.evidence: Common sense is always worth more than cunning.

questions.q: In 'The Boy and the Nettle', what did the mother tell the Boy to do next time?
choices: Pull it up by the roots
questions.evidence: grasp it firmly, and it will be as soft as silk

questions.q: What is the lesson of 'The Old Lion'?
choices: It is cowardly to attack someone who cannot defend himself
Lions are the kings of beasts
questions.evidence: It is cowardly to attack the defenseless

questions.q: In 'The Old Lion', which animal let fly his heels and brayed insults at the Lion?
questions.evidence: Even a contemptible Ass let fly his heels

questions.q: In 'The Fox and the Pheasants', why did the Pheasants fall off the limb?
choices: They watched the Fox dance so hard that they became dizzy
The Fox climbed up and pushed them
A strong wind blew them off
questions.evidence: so dazed did they become, that they lost their hold on the limb

questions.q: In 'Two Travelers and a Bear', what did one Man do when the Bear came?
choices: Climbed a tree and left his friend
questions.evidence: One of the Men, thinking of his own safety, climbed a tree.
